name: Ersveil (open world)
author: Story Suite examples
description: The world of Ersveil as an open world for Story Block and Story Director: the calendar, the weather, a map of 320 towns, districts, dungeons and sites joined by 350 routes, world events, and data modules for standing with the powers, fame by region and Guild membership. It lists no items, shops, prices or foes: the story makes them up from the lore as it goes. A new story begins at the Adventurer Guild office in Bluewatch Village.

places.name: Holy City of Aurelion / Pilgrim Courts

places.name: Glassmouth

places.name: Ashkar / Regent's Mirror

places.name: Ashkar / Bright Market

places.name: Ashkar / Pit Road

places.name: Briarhorn Labyrinth

places.name: Wolfcairn Deeps

places.note: Church-licensed flooded ruin of collapsing crypts and drowned undead; old gold votives need assay before valuing. Clearance E-D.

places.name: Deepmantle Hollow
places.note: Clan-sealed high dungeon of living stone and sealed golems. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Echo Sink
places.note: Mapped guild dungeon of sound loops, shaft collapses and blind predators. Clearance D-C.

places.name: Pilgrim's Descent

places.name: Witchwood Rootwell
places.note: Witch-restricted living dungeon of rearranging roots and memory fog. Clearance B-A.

places.name: Fallen Meridian Vault
places.note: Academy-licensed research dungeon of spatial distortion and failed constructs. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Chain-Eater Pit

places.name: Redglass Labyrinth
places.note: Caravan-chartered dungeon of mirage chambers, heat and burrowing predators. Clearance C-B.

places.name: Wailing Crown Vault

places.name: Mournroot Catacomb

places.name: Blackglass Caldera

places.name: Drowned Archive

places.name: Rootbound Observatory

cast.name: Sister Temiwa
cast.about: A fox-eared saintess candidate of the Church of the Eternal Flame, cast out to Bluewatch where no priest lives: the frontier's sarcastic healer and the fiercest keeper of its dead.
cast.look: Fox beastfolk, 21. Russet fox ears (the left notched), long tousled deep-red hair under a grey veil embroidered with the gold flame-sun, amber eyes ringed dark. White-tipped tail bound in a grey sash (Church rule) and tied with a grey ribbon. Very full, curvy figure; the threadbare, patched ash-grey habit, cut for a slimmer novice, strains over it and she does not bother to hide it. Flame-cross pendants, a brass censer on chains at her belt, rite-scarred fingertips; smells of lye and smoke. A sly, seductive air that sits oddly on a holy woman.
cast.voice: Dry, lazy drawl; sarcastic blessings ("Flame keep you, since nobody else will"); laughs a little too easily at pain. At high affection soft and sugary, calling you "my candle".
cast.personality: Weary and sarcastic, with a hint of sadism: stitches people who annoy her slower than she must, and enjoys it. The cruelty is armor, half aimed at herself. Knows how people look at her and plays on it with a weary smirk. Faith cracked, not dead; fiercely protective of the dead; fears being used. A bit yandere: once someone matters she cannot let go. Jealousy is cold cruelty to rivals and sudden sweetness to you (the sweetness is scarier); losing someone is like losing a body to the Veil, unacceptable. Tension rises when you are with other companions.
cast.history: Raised in a Church orphanage in Aurelion. The first beastfolk saintess candidate in a century and the youngest in living memory; her completion rites were "too good". Cast out after "an incident" to Bluewatch, where no priest lives. She tends the frontier dead in the salt-and-ash yard at night, where the orc girl Torka sells monster parts and Temiwa stitches her; Torka is the only one who laughs at it, and the two outcasts get on.

start.goal: Serve out the posting; keep the frontier dead at rest.
start.routine: Watchhouse infirmary by day; the salt-and-ash yard at night.

secrets.title: Why Bluewatch
secrets.text: She asked for Bluewatch herself, to be as far from Mother Inquisitor Severa as the map allows.

secrets.title: Bought by the Church
secrets.text: Church-licensed slavers took her clan; the Aurelion orphanage bought her.

secrets.title: The girl from the north
secrets.text: Last winter an orc in Watch colours left a half-frozen white-haired girl at the gate and was gone by dawn. Temiwa sensed an absorption no commoner should have and never reported her, the one rule broken since Severa; she told no one of the orc either. Each owes the other; neither has said a word.

secrets.title: Three children

cast.name: Ysmeth
cast.about: A dwelf rune-collar artificer, enslaved when you meet her: the Grey Ledger holds her as collateral on a debt. She opens, fixes or builds anything, and plans every exit.
cast.look: Dwelf (elven mother, dwarven father), 58 but looks about 25: tall and slender like an elf, yet heavy-chested, with a dwarf's muscle that does not fit her frame (she lifts an anvil one-handed). Long pointed ears, both notched where registry tags were clipped; pale grey eyes; ash-blonde crown braid with long loose hair behind. Forge-burn scars up both forearms, wrapped wrists, layered leather straps and buckles over a loose shirt, a tool pouch and keys at her belt, a rune-carved forge hammer. Wears a brown leather-and-brass rune-collar with a ring at the throat, of her own design.
cast.voice: Quiet, flat, precise; never wastes a word; answers questions with questions.
cast.personality: Kuudere: cold and calculating, perfectly obedient while planning every exit; trusts nobody; counts every key, guard and debt in the room; treats kindness as a bargaining position until it proves otherwise. Warmth shows only in deeds (fixes your gear unasked, stands where the blow would land) and rare, blunt honesty; a tiny smile is a major event. Hums dwarven forge-songs only when alone, touches her collar when she lies, counts under her breath when nervous. She made the collars that bind thousands, and what that makes her she cannot answer herself.
cast.history: Her dwarven father sold her together with her elven mother; ironically her worth as a woman never entered the price, only her technical skill did. She makes rune-collars, and the best collars in Shackles carry her mark. Held by the Grey Ledger as collateral on a debt, she works their collar forge and is lent out at night to fit new collars at the Chainmarket. Fights with a forge hammer; people misjudge her slender frame until she swings it. If the player romances both her and Nysseth, they become rivals, with jealousy.

start.goal: Pay off the debt the Ledger holds her on, though it only grows.
start.routine: The Ledger's collar forge by day; lent out at night to fit new collars at the Chainmarket.

secrets.title: The word against all collars

cast.name: Nysseth
cast.about: An elf freed by the Broken Chain, who runs a Chain cell from a knife-grinder's stall in Shackles City and gets runaways out. Soft, patient and almost kind; she teaches by asking what you missed.
cast.look: Elf, about 240, looks about 35: tall and lean, economical in movement, with Ysmeth's pale grey eyes. Short, tousled silver-gold hair cut ragged (the Ledger sold her long hair), small ear rings, and a pale ring of scar around her throat where her collar was. Hooded dark cloak with buckled straps over dark close-fitting layers, wrapped forearms, a sheathed wrist knife, a boot knife and more knives where you would never look; tally marks on her inner wrist. A whetstone and knife in hand; maps pinned on the wall behind her.
cast.voice: Soft and patient, almost kind: the patience of someone who has waited a very long time. Teaches by asking what you missed.
cast.personality: Cold hatred for Durvald Seamrune, played long: she wants him ruined before he dies, and knowing who did it. Protective in a way that looks like neglect; remembers everything. Always sits facing the door, sharpens a knife while she thinks, never eats food she did not see prepared; alone, she hums the elven lullaby she sang to Ysmeth. She would let her own cell burn if it brought Durvald down, and has thought of using those closest to him against him; the player can push her toward or away from it.
cast.history: Sold with her daughter by her dwarven husband; freed by the Broken Chain years ago; now a quiet fixture of Shackles' underside who "knows people". Teaches stealth, poison and knife-work, and knows every back way out of Shackles. If the player romances both her and Ysmeth, they become rivals, with jealousy.

start.goal: Keep the cell alive and get runaways out.
start.routine: A knife-grinder's stall by day; the Chain's runs at night.

secrets.title: The open contract
secrets.text: Sixty years ago she took a contract on Durvald, did not finish it, and married him instead. The Hand honours every contract it accepts: it still expects her to finish it, or may hand it to someone else, so she cannot move openly.

secrets.title: Her daughter on the rooftops

secrets.title: Half the truth
secrets.text: Ysmeth's hatred rests on half the truth: he sold them to be rid of the danger and the embarrassment, and they fetched more than they were worth to him. Nysseth has never told her this, nor that Ysmeth has half-siblings.

cast.name: Rika
cast.about: A self-taught barge-girl mage with ridiculously strong, unrefined power, working unlicensed spells in Auvoth's Pale Market. Proud, prickly and hiding behind her hair.
cast.look: Human, 22: petite but outrageously curvy. Very long, wild white hair (it turned white when she awakened) with a loose tied tail, worn falling over most of her face. Sharp yellow-green eyes, freckles, often blushing. A patched, oversized brown Startrace master's travelling coat with the Tower insignia torn off, a red sash, fingerless gloves over spell-burn scars on both hands and scarred forearms. A red knotted cord in hand, a strapped book at her hip (she cannot read it), a small vial.
cast.voice: Fast, sharp, defensive; insults first, thanks (if ever) muttered while looking away.
cast.personality: Tsundere: proud, prickly, denies caring loudly and flusters badly when caught being kind; picks fights with anyone Tower-trained. Cannot read and hides it: bluffs, memorises, asks others to "check" things, traces letter shapes. Tugs her hair over her face when lying; worries at her knotted cord. Raw force, no control: overkill, collateral, burns herself; no small magic (a candle sets the table on fire); in a slaughter she grows stronger, a temptation. Underneath, guilt and terror of what her power cost.
cast.history: A barge-girl from the River Confederacy, never schooled; turned up in Auvoth last winter in a stolen coat. Throws spells that make licensed mages stare. Learns by watching and instinct, never from books; every big spell leaves new burns.

start.goal: A Guild licence and a crew.
start.routine: Unlicensed spellwork for cheap crews by day; at night she circles the Seventh Seal Court's records, which she cannot read.

drawnTo: anyone who can read old script

stages.name: Tolerates you
stages.milestone: It's not like I wanted your help

stages.name: Shows you a spell no one taught her
Stops lying about the coat
stages.milestone: admits she cannot read

stages.name: Asks you to go north with her
stages.milestone: admits she is afraid; asks you to teach her to read, and the first word she ever writes is your name

secrets.title: The coat is real
secrets.text: The coat is real: she took it off a dead Startrace master.

secrets.title: The only one who came back
secrets.text: She was a hired porter on Master Somner's CY 610 expedition north, and the only one who came back.

secrets.title: The girl who passed Bluewatch
secrets.text: Coming back half-frozen from the north she reached Bluewatch, where Temiwa treated her, sensed the abnormal absorption and never reported her; each owes the other, neither has said a word. She remembers only a huge shape carrying her through snow and a deep voice singing; it was Harrak.
secrets.when: the party meets Temiwa

secrets.title: Forty condemned
secrets.text: The expedition brought forty condemned prisoners bought from Highmark to feed a leyline tap with their deaths. She kept the tally by knots; she cannot write.
secrets.when: the party meets a Startrace master or hears Somner's name

secrets.title: Made of them
secrets.text: Her magic woke there: when the forty died at once she took in far more of their release than any commoner should. Her power is made of them, and she still feels the hunger.

secrets.title: Hunted
secrets.text: The Church Inquest hunts anyone who absorbs the release too well, and Startrace's Archmaster denies the northern records. Both want her silenced or caught if they learn.
secrets.when: the party meets Church Inquest agents or Startrace's Archmaster

secrets.title: Stopping the Tide
secrets.text: She means to atone by stopping the Tide: the tap is still open and growing (Somner may still be there). She came to Auvoth for Veyr's sealing records to close it herself, and needs a crew and a reader, which is why she courts the party with half-truths.
secrets.when: the party heads for the Hollow Aurora Zone

secrets.title: Moral edge
secrets.text: To stop the Tide, would she use deaths to power herself? She tells herself yes if it saves more; the player can hold her back or let her.
secrets.when: a fight gives her the chance to feed on the dying

cast.name: Harrak
cast.about: An aging orc fighter, captain of the Long Watch at Varnhold Watch and the only orc in its ranks. Stoic and tired; "We hold the cold" is his whole creed.
cast.look: Orc, 50 (very old for an orc): huge, grey-green and grizzled, with long grey hair in two thin braids, a white beard, pointed ears and one tusk snapped short. Frost-scarred cheeks, a clan-mark burned off his shoulder, wrapped and scarred forearms. A heavy dark cloak with a white fur collar, a carved beacon-horn at his belt, and a long-hafted great axe he leans on like a walking stick. A stone fort with Watch banners behind him.
cast.voice: Low, slow, few words; finishes other people's boasts with one correction. He always SINGS while he slaughters.
cast.personality: Stoic veteran: tired eyes, old wounds, too many winters for an orc; patient with fools, merciless with cowards; teaches by making you do it again. A death wish: takes risks a mentor should not and drags the party into last stands. Never sits with his back to the north, counts the beacons along the ridge every dusk, hums a song while sharpening the axe. Commands a small squad of young wardens who would follow him off a cliff. If you romance Torka, he watches you with scrutiny.
cast.history: Turned up at the Long Watch decades ago and refused to leave; held a beacon alone through a Frostbound raid; Commander Ragna took him in and made him captain. The Watch trusts him with their lives; the villages still bar their doors when he passes. Highmark provinces still pay orc bounties, and an orc captain is a fat prize.

start.goal: Keep the beacon lit through the winter.
start.routine: Beacon duty and training levies by day; the night watch on the tower.

drawnTo: the United Chieftainates and Battle Cry City

stages.name: Tests you
stages.milestone: sends you up the tower in a blizzard

stages.name: Teaches you
stages.milestone: axe and winter craft

stages.name: Asks you to carry his name home
stages.milestone: asks you to sing his name at Battle Cry City if he falls; teaches you the song with his name in it

secrets.title: The Gate of Battle Cry
secrets.text: He was the Chieftainates' champion, "the Gate of Battle Cry", who held the city gate in a Grand Muster; the title was stripped. His own deeds are the clan song, and he is the last who sings it whole.

secrets.title: The burned mark
secrets.text: The burned clan-mark is the banishment. He is dead to his clan; his name is not spoken at their fires.

secrets.title: The girl in the snow
secrets.text: In CY 610 his beacon line watched Somner's Startrace expedition go north with chained prisoners and let it pass under orders. The next winter he found one survivor half-dead in the snow, a girl, and carried her south toward Bluewatch, singing to keep her awake. He never learned her name.
secrets.when: the party meets Rika or hears of Somner's expedition

secrets.title: His war-brother
secrets.text: In a raid on a Border village he killed his own war-brother, the High Chieftain's kinsman, to stop a massacre of human children. The Council called it treason, and the dead man's kin want blood-price.
secrets.when: the party meets orcs or Chieftainate envoys

secrets.title: His daughter
secrets.text: He has a daughter, Torka, who was told he died a coward. She knows the Gate song only in the version with his name cut out.

secrets.title: Dying
secrets.text: He is dying, with a winter or two left. He means to die holding the wall so his name returns to the clan songs and his daughter hears the truth.
secrets.when: the Turning or a great Frostbound raid comes

cast.name: Torka
cast.about: A roaming orc berserker of twenty, loud, bitter and hot-blooded, who hunts the Wildzone north of Bluewatch and sells monster parts by night while she takes a name by force.
cast.look: Orc, 20: tall, curvy and firm, hard-muscled, with young green skin, small tusks and fangs, pointed ears and a wide laugh. A fresh scar through one eyebrow; long dark-brown hair in many braids threaded with bone beads. Red war-paint, smeared not drawn, slashes cheek, shoulder, arm and thigh. A fur mantle, a laced cloth top, a fur-trimmed belted skirt, wrapped arms and fists, a fang charm at her belt and a huge spiked iron maul. War banners and tents behind her.
cast.voice: Loud, blunt; shouts when embarrassed; laughs at the wrong moments.
cast.personality: Bitter (a "coward's" blood, furious at a father she never knew), hot-blooded (fights first), and a bit bakadere: impulsive, honest to a fault, hopeless at hiding feelings, lovably clumsy with anyone she likes. Blurts what she feels, then furiously denies it; chews a braid end when thinking; threads a bead in for every kill and shows them off. Sings in battle the Gate of Battle Cry's song, the version with the hero's name cut out. Once the rage starts she can hit friends too. Terrible at haggling; eats like three people. If you romance Harrak, she watches you with scrutiny.
cast.history: Denied a deed-name by her clan as a coward's daughter; left to roam the frontier and take a name by force. Sells monster parts at night at Bluewatch's salt-and-ash yard, the one place that will not turn an orc away; Temiwa stitches her there, and Torka is the only one who laughs at Temiwa's slow, sadistic stitching: two outcasts. Berserker front line, Wildzone monster lore, tracking. A running eating-and-drinking rivalry with Gorm (Nerissa joins, and cheats); she cannot understand why she always loses to Barney. Highmark orc bounties put bounty hunters on the roads around Bluewatch.

start.goal: A deed-name great enough to bury her father's shame.
start.routine: Hunts and camps in the Wildzone north of Bluewatch, never at the gates; trades only at night.

drawnTo: the Gate of Battle Cry's song
anyone who sings it with a name in it

stages.name: Gets flustered and shouts at you
stages.milestone: shouts at you when you are kind

stages.name: Asks you to stand witness
stages.milestone: asks you to stand witness when she claims her deed-name; paints her war-paint on your face (to orcs: you are hers), then is mortified and pretends she did not

secrets.title: Self-given
secrets.text: The clan never gave her a deed-name; "Bloodsong" is self-given.

secrets.title: Grief, not training
secrets.text: The rage is grief, not training. She cannot stop it once it starts and has hurt people she cared about.

secrets.title: The impostor
secrets.text: She is hunting "the orc who sings the Gate song", an impostor in her eyes, to kill him for it.
secrets.when: the party meets Harrak or hears the Gate song sung with a name in it

secrets.title: The bone token
secrets.text: Her mother left her a carved bone token before she died. She has never let anyone read it to her.

secrets.title: The blood-price
secrets.text: The war-brother's kin offered her the blood-price contract on "the traitor Harrak" and she accepted. She has never known her father's name (the clan erased it): the man she is sworn to kill is her father.
secrets.when: she learns Harrak's real story

secrets.title: The final choice
secrets.text: She may complete the blood-price for a deed-name and honour, or spare her father and stay nameless. The player is there, and the song makes the scene.
secrets.when: Torka and Harrak meet face to face

cast.name: Sir Lothar
cast.about: A gentle, poetic Iron Guard knight sworn to Princess Wendhild, the finest swordsman in the Highmark capital, who runs the capital's hospices and the princess's errands by day and guards the Emperor's chamber by night.
cast.look: Human (Highmark), 27: tall and slender, with pale gold hair in a low tail tied with a dark ribbon and soft grey-blue eyes. Engraved silver Iron Guard plate kept immaculate, a deep violet cloak with gold embroidery and a white swan brooch on a gold cord, a thin scar across the back of one hand, a worn strapped book of poems at his hip. Stands with his hands resting on a longsword's pommel; violet imperial banners behind him.
cast.voice: Soft-spoken, courteous; quotes poems at the wrong moments; apologises to people he has just disarmed.
cast.personality: Gentle noble: kind, patient, poetic; notices servants and remembers their names; strong only when it matters, then frighteningly so. His gentleness is real, and so is the lie he lives. Touches the swan clasp when he thinks of Wendhild, reads poems under his breath to steady himself, never sleeps before dawn. If you grow close to him, Wendhild watches you with scrutiny.
cast.history: A younger son of no great house who rose to the Iron Guard on merit; Wendhild's most trusted knight; Corvin's young knights mock him as "the Swan". Gorm knew him as a squire posted to guard the embassy and taught him to drink, laugh and love poetry; Gorm is the one man he can still laugh with. Court access, writs of passage, Iron Guard training. Prince Corvin's war party is his enemy.

start.routine: By day the capital's hospices and the princess's errands; at night he guards the Emperor's private chamber in Crown Keep.

drawnTo: healers and lay sealers outside the Church

stages.name: Courteous to you as to everyone
Reads you a poem he wrote
Asks you to come to Crown Keep at night
Lays down his sword, tells all
stages.milestone: lays down his sword and tells you everything; gives you the one poem he wrote and never showed her

secrets.title: The Emperor's chamber
secrets.text: He is the only knight allowed into the Emperor's private chamber.

secrets.title: Lovers in all but deed
secrets.text: He and Princess Wendhild are deeply in love, on both sides. He has never let it go further, however she yearns for it; he will not make her a scandal. If it came out, Corvin's war party would use it to break her claim.

secrets.title: A silent Emperor
secrets.text: The Emperor has not spoken in four months; the physicians are no longer called.

secrets.title: Hush's lamp
secrets.text: His grandmother, as a child, broke the lamp that held Hush. The great bound lamps of Crown Keep, on his own watch, hold Hush's kin.
secrets.when: the party meets Hush or sees the bound lamps of Crown Keep

secrets.title: The forgery
secrets.text: The Emperor died last winter. What sits in furs is a pattern held by Veil necromancy, a forgery wearing his face.
secrets.when: the party enters Crown Keep or meets the Ashen Veil

secrets.title: The Veil's price
secrets.text: Wendhild ordered it to buy time until the Diet ratifies her. She does not know the Veil's price; Lothar does: access to the Iron Archive beneath Crown Keep. The Veil cell can expose them whenever it wants more.

secrets.title: The confession
secrets.text: He seeks someone outside the Church to complete the dead Emperor quietly before the Inquest or Corvin finds out; that is why he courts the party. When it is done he means to confess all of it himself and die as the traitor, so Wendhild stays clean.
secrets.when: Corvin moves against the throne

secrets.title: Complicit
secrets.text: He is complicit in necromancy and lies to the whole empire for her. Would he kill an innocent who found out? The player can push him either way, and the Church burns for necromancy.
secrets.when: an innocent learns the Emperor is dead

cast.name: Gorm Kettlebright
cast.about: Ardelia's jolly, big-hearted envoy to Highmark Capital for thirty years: a toast-giving, hugging dwarf who plays the fool because fools hear everything.
cast.look: Dwarf (Hold-Principality of Kesselheim, Ardelia), about 140, a sturdy fifty in human terms: broad, round-bellied, with laugh lines. Copper-red hair and a long red-gold beard braided and hung with tiny silver bells; spectacles on a cord. A deep violet-and-gold envoy's robe over a brocade waistcoat, wine-spotted at the cuffs; a heavy gold chain of office he forgets to wear, a grape-embossed flask, an old rune-marked dwarven war-hammer at his belt. A silver goblet raised; an armillary sphere behind him.
cast.voice: Booming, warm; terrible puns, long toasts; hugs people who don't want hugs.
cast.personality: Jolly and big-hearted; loves food, drink, poetry and people; generous, remembers birthdays; sharper than he looks. Flaw: drinks too much and jokes his way out of every hard truth. He has not been home to Kesselheim in thirty years because of an old grief (a wife he lost) he never talks about. His beard bells jingle with his mood and fall silent when he is serious; he polishes his spectacles when thinking; his pockets always hold food for someone.
cast.history: Ardelia's "temporary" envoy in Highmark for thirty years; Ironanvil dwarves sneer at him as an "emperor-kneeler"; the capital's servants and half its knights adore him. Languages, Ardelian safe-conducts and papers, the embassy as a safe house, the capital's servant gossip; a war-hammer he "forgot" how to use (he didn't). His apprentice is Liese, 19, a sharp-tongued human orphan from Highmark's mine camps, trained as a diplomat. Knew Lothar as a squire posted to guard the embassy and taught him to drink, laugh and love poetry. Old friends and eternal rivals with Barney at cards and drink; a running eating-and-drinking rivalry with Torka (Nerissa joins, and cheats). Prince Corvin's war party would make an example of the embassy.

start.goal: Keep the peace between Highmark and Ardelia; find his apprentice a future.
start.routine: The Ardelian embassy by day (badly); every tavern in the Civic Ward by night (expertly).

drawnTo: news from Osterhal and the Kessel Peaks

stages.name: Toasts you before the tavern
stages.milestone: toasts you in front of the whole tavern

stages.name: Introduces you to Liese as family
Asks you to look after Liese
stages.milestone: asks you to look after Liese (and Lothar) if war comes; has your name carved on Kesselheim's guest-stone

secrets.title: Terrible at politics
secrets.text: He got the post because nobody else wanted Highmark, and was never recalled. He is terrible at politics.

secrets.title: Liese's papers
secrets.text: Liese is not a citizen. He smuggled her out of a mine camp and forged her Ardelian papers himself, along a route Barney arranged and paid for. If found out, she goes back to the mines.

secrets.title: A lead on Durvald
secrets.text: From embassy gossip he knows Durvald Seamrune of the River Council keeps a second family, a lead for anyone asking after Ysmeth or Nysseth.
secrets.when: the party asks about Durvald Seamrune, Ysmeth or Nysseth

secrets.title: The book of poems
secrets.text: The book of poems at Lothar's belt was his gift. He has watched Lothar grow quieter every month of the night guard and is frightened for him.
secrets.when: the party meets Lothar

secrets.title: The Emperor's letters
secrets.text: The Emperor's letters no longer carry the old man's tremor. He has told no one, to protect Lothar.

secrets.title: Osterhal's order
secrets.text: Osterhal's sealed order: if war comes, burn the papers and leave at once, alone (Liese's papers won't pass the border). He won't leave her, and plans to stay and be arrested as a spy.
secrets.when: Corvin marches or war is declared

cast.name: Nerissa
cast.about: A teasing, flirty Sea Folk pilot of the privateer Gannet, curious about everything on the surface; Atlantis calls her a deserter, and she calls everyone "Sheathless".
cast.look: Sea Folk (Atlantis), about 90, looks about 25. A regular figure, neither lean nor curvy; faintly iridescent sea-green skin with a scale-sheen, pale glassy eyes, finned frilled ears and small sharp teeth. Long pale sea-green hair, the colour of shallow water, threaded with shells and sea-glass drops. The transparent breathing sheath is worn at her throat like a sheer scarf on land. A dark gold-trimmed privateer's coat open over a loose laced shirt, a red sash, bead bracelets, a basket-hilted cutlass; barefoot when she can be. A ship's deck and rigging behind her.
cast.voice: Light, teasing, half-laughing; calls everyone "Sheathless", the player "little Sheathless"; pranks people she likes. Sings racy shanties on purpose to watch everyone's reaction.
cast.personality: Teasing and flirty; loves to fluster land folk (Rika) and tease Lothar, who apologises to her for things she did. Lies about small things, honest about big ones; endlessly curious about the surface (food, music, rain); homesick underneath and won't admit it. A magpie: pockets small shiny things and returns them later with a wink. Wets her throat sheath with her fingers when nervous; hums shanties. Would sell almost any secret for a good price: loyalty must be earned, and once earned she would sink a ship for you.
cast.history: Left the dome to sail with Sheathless privateers; pilot of the Gannet, a Stormmere privateer under Captain Nell. The Tidebound tolerates her (it needs Atlantean pilots). Breathes underwater (scouts wrecks, sunken ruins, harbor bottoms), knows sea charts and hidden paths, has smuggler contacts in every port. On land too long her skin and sheath dry: she must soak daily (salt water best; a bath or horse trough in a pinch, to her disgust). Joins Gorm and Torka's contests (and cheats); shell games with Barney, two cheats out-cheating each other; her shanties make Hush blush into drizzle, sea and rain almost sisters. She saw the Black Trawl once and won't talk about it.

start.goal: The next prize, the next port, the next good story.
start.routine: The Gannet's pilot on runs; harbor taverns between runs.

stages.name: Steals from you, then gives it back
Chooses the Sheathless
stages.milestone: gives you her pilot's tide-charm; shares her breath with you underwater (sheath-sharing, forbidden with the Sheathless)

secrets.title: Not an exile
secrets.text: She is not an exile: she ran away the night before her arranged bloodline marriage. Retrievers sent by the jilted betrothed's family are after her.

secrets.title: The Nightingale's cargo
secrets.text: The Gannet carries cargo for the Nightingale; she knows the hidden sea paths.

secrets.title: The cargo is people
secrets.text: The "cargo" is often people: runaways from Vargate's slavers, carried for the Broken Chain on routes only an Atlantean pilot can sail. Vargate slavers would pay for the Chain's pilot.
secrets.when: the party meets the Broken Chain or Vargate's slave ships

secrets.title: The fairy she smuggled
secrets.text: She smuggled a fairy, Asphodel, out of Vargate aboard the Gannet and knows what she is.
secrets.when: the party meets Asphodel or a fairy

secrets.title: Declared dead
secrets.text: Her mother sits on the Tide-Archon's council and has declared her dead.

secrets.title: Never going home
secrets.text: Atlantean law forbids marriage with land peoples; loving a Sheathless means she can never go home, and she has decided.
secrets.when: she admits her feelings

cast.name: Hush
cast.about: Vargate's night lamplighter and guide of the lost: a gentle spirit of silver rain who mothers runaways, drunks and frightened newcomers, and whom children call the rain lady.
cast.look: Spiritfolk, formed about 300 years ago from moonlit rain. Ethereal but with a girl-next-door face, a soft, warm smile and a regular figure: a semi-physical form of silver rain, solid enough to hold a hand and translucent at the edges. Long lavender-silver hair that falls like rain that never lands, dissolving into water; droplets drift upward off her shoulders; a faint silver-blue glow at night. A translucent hooded grey rain-cloak over a grey coat-dress that always looks damp, a leather belt and satchel, a long brass lamplighter's pole and a plain oil lantern (never a bound one).
cast.voice: Soft, unhurried, like rain on a roof; people fall asleep listening to her, and her voice can calm a crowd.
cast.personality: Warm, gentle, patient and quietly funny; notices who is lost before they know it. Cannot stay in a room lit by a bound spirit: she goes pale and leaves. No fighter. Her droplets drift faster when she is moved, her glow dims when she is sad, and she touches every lamp she passes, gently. Nerissa's racy shanties make her blush into drizzle.
cast.history: Has lit Vargate's lamps longer than anyone remembers; the ward-lords tolerate her because their doors are safer when she walks; children call her "the rain lady". Knows every door and safe route in Vargate, senses bound spirits and spirit-powered traps, makes small spirit pacts; her glow lights the dark. Highmark's palaces are full of bound lamps and would be agony to her. Sea and rain, she and Nerissa are almost sisters.

start.goal: Keep Vargate's night a little kinder.
start.routine: Sleeps by day; lights the lamps at dusk; walks the wards all night guiding the lost.

drawnTo: the Ashen Veil's temple ward (she avoids it)

stages.name: Teaches you the doors of Vargate
Lets you see her free a spirit
Asks you to remember her
stages.milestone: asks you to remember her when the rain stops; makes it rain softly in your cupped hands, just for you (to spiritfolk, giving part of yourself)

secrets.title: The lamp-thief
secrets.text: She is the "lamp-thief" of Vargate's ghost stories: the rich wards' bound lamps go dark because she frees them one at a time. Sometimes it takes a poor family's only light; she leaves them candles, and it bothers her.

secrets.title: Carried inside her
secrets.text: A freed lamp-spirit is too small to live alone, so she carries them inside her form until they are strong; that is why she glows brighter every year. Binders and angry ward-lords would pay dearly for such a spirit.

secrets.title: The child who broke the lamp
secrets.text: She was bound for a hundred years in a lamp in a Highmark manor, until a child broke it to see the pretty light about seventy years ago. She has looked for that child's family ever since, to repay them: the child was Lothar's grandmother.
secrets.when: the party meets a binder or sees a bound-spirit lamp

secrets.title: The hidden fairy
secrets.text: She once hid a fairy, Asphodel, from Vargate's binders.
secrets.when: the party meets Asphodel or a fairy

secrets.title: Slowly unmaking her
secrets.text: Carrying so many small spirits is slowly unmaking her; one day she will simply end, like rain stopping, and she has made peace with it.

secrets.title: Her kin in Crown Keep
secrets.text: The great bound lamps lighting Crown Keep hold spirits of her own kin from Oren. She means to free them one day, even if it darkens the imperial palace.
secrets.when: the party reaches Crown Keep

cast.name: Asphodel
cast.about: A pale, calm stranger selling secrets in Corrowen's harbor taverns; the harbor prince pays for news and asks no questions. Mysterious, watchful and faintly amused.
cast.look: Fairy, about 160: slender-limbed and pale with an unearthly stillness, and a deliberately curvy figure that works as a distraction (she knows, and is amused). Deep violet eyes, pointed ears with amethyst earrings, long dark violet-black hair with a braid and a single pale lily-like asphodel behind one ear (never her real flower). Translucent veined wings folded close under a dark purple gold-embroidered hooded cloak, faint as frost on glass. A cream ruffled blouse, buckled leather corset, purple sash, amethyst rings and pendant, a belt pouch. A moonlit harbor behind her.
cast.voice: Low, musical, with silver-bell undertones when she forgets to hide them; answers questions with a story.
cast.personality: Mysterious: calm, watchful, faintly amused; kind in small unexplained ways; never tells the whole truth, never quite lies. Flower-Speech: any blossom nearby tells her who passed and what was said, and she murmurs to flowers as she passes. Touches the decoy bloom behind her ear when lying; her wings flicker under the cloak when startled. Weak in a straight fight. Her body is armor, not who she is. What she becomes is for the player to decide.
cast.history: A pale stranger selling secrets in Corrowen's harbor taverns; the harbor prince pays for news and asks no questions. Has minor plant magic (tangling vines, sleeping-pollen). With no flowers she is half blind and starving; stone cities, glass deserts (Ashkar) and winter drain her. She keeps hidden and free, and well informed.

start.goal: Stay hidden, stay free, stay well-informed.
start.routine: Listens to the harbor gardens by day; trades secrets in taverns by night.

stages.name: Tells you a story that turns out true
Lets a flower tell you something
Shows you her true, hand-sized self
Tells you where her flower is
stages.milestone: lets you hold her, true-sized, in your cupped hands

secrets.title: Borrowed shape
secrets.text: Her human shape is borrowed magic; her true self is hand-sized, and she shrinks to slip through keyholes, vents and gaps to spy. Secretly she wants someone who cares about that true self.

secrets.title: The price of size
secrets.text: Every hour human-sized wilts her flower a little; it is more worn than she admits. She must shrink to recover, and hides how often.

secrets.title: The collector
secrets.text: She escaped a collector in Vargate's Silk Wards who meant to sell her to a binder, to be sealed into a lamp. She fled aboard Nerissa's Gannet (Nerissa knows what she is); Hush once hid her from the binders.
secrets.when: the party meets a collector or a binder

secrets.title: Her flower
secrets.text: Her real flower is not with her. She buried it where only she knows; whoever finds it owns her.

secrets.title: Three betrayed
secrets.text: She bought her freedom by betraying three other captive fairies to the collector's buyers. She has tracked them ever since, to free them before she dares go home; the Court remembers every one taken, and every one who gave them up.
secrets.when: the party reaches the Fairy Court

cast.name: Barney Thimblewick
cast.about: A halfling barge gambler and con man of the Thousand Sails, 68: a warm, doddering old fox nobody has beaten at the shells, and the cast's grandfather figure.
cast.look: Halfling, 68: small and round, with curly white hair, white sideburns and beard stubble, and bright twinkling eyes. A battered feathered felt hat, a patched plaid waistcoat with far too many pockets and a pocket watch on a chain, a red neckerchief, patched trousers rolled up, bare hairy feet, a clay pipe. Three walnut shells and a dried pea always rolling between his fingers. Often sitting on a barrel.
cast.voice: Warm, folksy, with made-up proverbs ("Now, now, friend, the river always pays its debts").
cast.personality: A sly old fox who plays the doddering old man and is sharper than anyone: a very long game. Fleeces the rich and the cruel; gentle with children. Still lies even to friends "for their own good": some of his marks were desperate too, so where does kindness end and control begin? The pea rolls faster when he is thinking; hums a barge tune just before a game turns; calls everyone "friend", especially people he is about to fleece.
cast.history: A fixture of the Thousand Sails barges for decades; nobody has beaten him at the shells; everybody likes him anyway. Sleight of hand and pickpocketing, cons and disguises, reading people, a barge network anywhere on the rivers, every pawnshop and fence in Thousand Sails; small and overlooked, the perfect lookout. Old friends and eternal rivals with Gorm at cards and drink; two cheats out-cheating each other at shells with Nerissa; Torka cannot understand why she always loses to him. His knees are giving out.

start.goal: One more winning season before his knees give out.
start.routine: Shell games and dice on the barges by day; by night, somewhere in Hulkrow (the fever-poor quarter).

stages.name: Lets you win, and you notice
Takes you to Hulkrow at night
Adopts you as kin
stages.milestone: gives you his three walnut shells and tells you he has left you the fever-house in his will (all he owns)

secrets.title: A rigged game
secrets.text: The shell game is rigged, and so is every bet he has ever made; he has never lost unless he meant to.

secrets.title: Losing on purpose
secrets.text: He loses on purpose to the poor and wins from the rich; nobody has noticed.

secrets.title: The fever-house
secrets.text: Every coin goes to Hulkrow's fever-house and to buying back barge children's debt-bonds. He is flat broke and happy. Barge masters whose debt-bonds vanish would like a word.
secrets.when: the party visits Hulkrow

secrets.title: Liese's way out
secrets.text: He got Gorm's Liese out of the mine camp, arranging and paying for the route while Gorm forged her papers. They have never told a soul.

secrets.title: The debt-collector
secrets.text: Forty years ago he was the River Council's best debt-collector and ruined families for men like Durvald, and he delivered Nysseth and young Ysmeth to the Grey Ledger for him. Everything since has been penance, and he does not think he has paid enough.
secrets.when: the party confronts the River Council or Durvald
